meta.title: Lao Phrases and Expressions
meta.subtitle: 79 entries · 5 phrases, 72 sentences, 2 proverbs · both directions
meta.desc: 79 Lao phrases, sentences and proverbs, in three subdecks: 5 everyday phrases, 72 short sentences and 2 proverbs. Both study directions come as two cards of one entry — Lao → English (see the Lao, recall the meaning) and English → Lao (see the English, recall the Lao) — each with a schedule of its own. This is a companion to the level decks, Lao A1 to B1, and not one of them; nothing here is a word a level deck already teaches, so the two can be studied together without repeating an entry. WHY SENTENCES: English Wiktionary, the source of every Lao meaning on this shelf, holds only a handful of Lao set phrases and two proverbs, and the levels already teach the commonest greetings. So the PHRASES are the ones Wiktionary has that no level teaches (ຈັງໃດ, ຈັກໂມງ, ຂ້ອຍຊື່ …), the PROVERBS are its two, and the SENTENCES are real everyday sentences from Tatoeba with Tatoeba's own English translation (ຂອບໃຈຫຼາຍ., ບໍ່ເຂົ້າໃຈ., ຂ້ອຍເມົາລົດ. …), shortest first. Every entry is printed in Lao script with a romanisation beneath it, each syllable followed by its tone in Chao tone letters, as on the level cards. A sentence's romanisation is built word by word from each word's Wiktionary pronunciation — only sentences where every word has one are included — so it shows each word as said on its own; in running speech an unstressed syllable can be shorter. Sources. Phrases, proverbs, meanings and pronunciation: English Wiktionary, via the kaikki.org extraction (CC BY-SA 4.0). Sentences and their translations: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), CC BY 2.0 FR.
